All Auction Quantities submissions for today's auction have not been received by the initial cut-off time 4:30PM today. As a result, the day-ahead auction will be delayed. The new cut-off times are:
Auction Quantities submissions from Facility Operators due by 6:30PM today (07/08/2026)
AEMO to publish Auction Quantities report by 6:45PM today (07/08/2026)
Auction bid submissions from Auction Participants due by 7:00PM today (07/08/2026)
AEMO to publish Auction Results report by 7:30PM today (07/08/2026)
